answer: A practical defence is Stamped meteorite dealer registration with meteorite society attestation. It rests on a registration the society renews after provenance audits, which gives every honest agent a lantern that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a registration the society renews after provenance audits takes calendar time as well as money — and the gale is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the vault is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
